pbo.reading: share of in-sample/out-of-sample partitions in which the in-sample champion finished BELOW the out-of-sample median. 0.5 is a coin flip.
pbo.pbo_baseline_derivation: the OOS rank is discrete: rank = (j+1)/(N+1) for j = 0..N-1, and PBO counts lambda = log(rank/(1-rank)) <= 0, i.e. j+1 <= (N+1)/2. Under pure noise j is uniform, so the baseline is floor((N+1)/2)/N = 0.5 at N = 8.

HOW_TO_READ.the_caveat_that_decides_the_reading: PBO ranks arms by Sharpe on the SAME monthly index, and the 3m/6m/12m arms are OVERLAPPING books: 1/h of the portfolio rolls each month, so their monthly series are serially smoothed and their monthly Sharpes are mechanically higher than a 1m book's at the same economic edge. A POOLED family that mixes horizons therefore lets the in-sample selector escape into the smoothest arm, and its low PBO is partly a statement about overlap, not about stability. The PER-HORIZON blocks compare like with like and are the honest reading.
HOW_TO_READ.reading: pooled across horizons the 32-cell grid reads SELECTION_IS_STABLE at PBO 0.0143. Per horizon it does not: 1m 0.5286 (SELECTION_IS_OVERFIT), 3m 0.1429 (SELECTION_IS_STABLE), 6m 0.1286 (SELECTION_IS_STABLE), 12m 0.4857 (SELECTION_IS_FRAGILE). The 1m horizon is the one the books actually trade.

SEED_SELECTION_FINDING.reading: the shadow contract forbids seed selection and judges the SEED-MEAN. These counts say why: in neural_family_10bps_PRIMARY_paired_excess an individual seed wins 15 of 15 in-sample partitions; neural_family_25bps_PRIMARY_paired_excess an individual seed wins 15 of 15 in-sample partitions; POOLED_all_cost_rates_PRIMARY_paired_excess an individual seed wins 15 of 15 in-sample partitions; POOLED_all_cost_rates_SECONDARY_net an individual seed wins 14 of 15 in-sample partitions. A leaderboard whose top row is one seed of eight is the maximum of eight draws quoted as one, and PBO measures exactly that.

neural_family.cost_rates_note: the same arm at 10 and 25 bps is TWO cells in the pooled family because the search reported both and a reader may pick either. It is not two independent arms, and the pooled PBO is therefore an optimistic reading of a family whose members are near-duplicates -- said here rather than discovered later.

headline: 32-cell learner grid pooled: PBO 0.0143 vs its own noise baseline 0.5 -- but AT 1m, the horizon the books trade, PBO 0.5286 vs 0.5 = AT THE COIN FLIP; CPCV OOS annualised median 0.06438, 0.1333 of paths negative | neural family (22 of 40 cells reconstructible): PBO 0.3286 vs baseline 0.5; an INDIVIDUAL SEED wins 15 of 15 in-sample CPCV partitions at 10 bps, never the seed-mean
